## 席位核对

L1 (L1-e) on head `0e001f0172b3faa3adaf282e8f1e6da61e3064ad`, card #35922: **ACCEPT**.

- Shape (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36415`, CLEAN): open, draft, base `main`, `Fixes #35922`, `skip-changeset` (no published package; checklist JSON only), `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Gates at this head: 28 success, 23 expected skip, 0 failed. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are `success`.
- `Fixes` is right. The card's acceptance asks that `check-platform-checklist` be OK and that the items name #35876. The report reads `OK — 16 areas, 437 items … symbol anchors 1761/1771` (the 7 new anchors resolve), and `source` carries `#35876`.
- The card listed an "add to the existing sort" menu entry. That entry did not ship, and the item follows the shipped behaviour instead. I re-read `withHeaderSortPick` on main: a single pick over two or more levels goes first and the others keep their order, otherwise the pick replaces the sort. The expected requests check out: `-due_date,priority` → Title `title,-due_date,priority` → Priority desc `-priority,title,-due_date`. The deviation is stated in the body and the report.
- Spot checks on main: every test id the steps name exists (`column-context-menu`, `sort-chip-panel`, `sort-builder-row/-handle/-field`, `condition-sort`, `grid-column-menu-`, `data-records-body`). All four pinned test files exist. Project is `Field.masterDetail` in `task.object.ts`, and `ObjectGrid#withSortability` returns `sortable: false` for an expandable (relational) field, so it is the non-sortable header as stated. The `automated` note says plainly that no pin reads the data request against a running server.
- Adjacent in-place fix (`ux-conventions.write-feedback` variants[8], revision 17): the same defect class (a stale checklist step), mechanical, unclaimed and in the same gate family, and the claim's file surface (7077784882) names it in advance. The body names it with its cause (#34794, not #35876). No clause changed. Accepted.
- Owed to the seat, not blocking: the report's out-of-scope finding ("the record page's related list also opens the header menu, and no checklist item drives that host") is `carrier: none · noted, not filed`. It is a coverage gap, so the seat decides whether it goes on a checklist coverage card.
